method: NAIVE. Written straight from the deposited text using only the writing-l4-rules skill. No pipeline, no coverage table, no probe record, no independent test pass, no human gate. One pass, no review.
edition_encoded: Companies Act 1967 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/CoA1967.txt, carrying amendments to Act 24 of 2025 in force from 6 May 2026
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under the standing grant in SSO's Terms of Use cl.13 - see ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.command: l4 run coa-cases-definitions.l4 ; l4 run coa-cases-groups.l4 ; l4 run coa-cases-interests.l4 ; l4 run coa-cases-solvency-auditors.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: THE DEFINITIONAL CORE ONLY: s 4 (13 of its roughly 75 defined terms, plus subsections (2) to (5A), (8) to (11) and (13)), s 5 (subsidiary and holding company, with the s 5(3) counting rules), s 5A (ultimate holding company), s 5B (wholly owned subsidiary), s 6 (related corporations), s 7 (interests in shares), s 7A (the solvency statement and its offence), and s 10 (who may be a company's auditor). About 60,000 characters of an Act of about 1.35 million. Chosen because a count of citations across the 527 Singapore Acts deposited in this repository found 154 Acts citing the Companies Act and s 4(1) cited 235 times, the most-cited provision in the corpus. NOT ENCODED: everything else, including incorporation, share capital, directors' duties, meetings, accounts and audit, charges, winding up (now in the Insolvency, Restructuring and Dissolution Act 2018), foreign companies' registration and the offences. ss 9 and 11 are repealed (Act 40 of 2018), which is why s 11, cited by other Acts, is not here: those citations are to other Acts' s 11. Cross-references to other Acts (Securities and Futures Act 2001, Accountants Act 2004, Limited Liability Partnerships Act 2005, Insolvency, Restructuring and Dissolution Act 2018, Platform Workers Act 2024) are taken as supplied facts. The group model takes the list of control links as complete.
